purpose: Declares the connector lanes each agent and certification run requires. A run must verify availability BEFORE any certification claim, retrieval, or registry update. A missing required connector is an immediate HOLD - never a partial run, and never a substitution of reported data for retrieved data.
rule: Preflight first. Verify every required connector is present before any other work.
A missing required connector returns HOLD immediately, names the exact missing lane(s), makes no certification claim, and makes no registry version update.
Never substitute a reported version, value, or record for one that was not retrieved.
Partial certification is not a permitted outcome.

daily-revenue-command-center.note: FUB task/contact reads, Drive canonical source retrieval, Calendar reconciliation.

client-prep-brief.note: FUB contact/notes/appointments, Drive canonical retrieval, Calendar appointment verification.

lead-conversion-crm.note: FUB reads for target resolution and duplicate/state checks; Drive for controlling FUB SOPs. Calendar optional (due-date context).

buyer-investor-ops.note: FUB relationship reads, Drive SOPs and client assets, Calendar showing/appointment verification. MLS is a Chrome-operator handoff, never a connector here.

seller-listing-ops.note: FUB seller reads, Drive seller SOP chain and assets, Calendar listing/appointment timing. MLS and ShowingTime are Chrome-operator handoffs.

market-intel-marketing.note: FUB read-only for deduplication and active-lead exclusion; Drive for prospecting SOP, prompts and filing. Calendar optional (open houses). MLS/InfoSparks is a Chrome-operator handoff.

transaction-closing-ops.note: FUB transaction relationship reads, Drive executed documents and SOPs, Calendar deadline control. Click Contracts and SkySlope are Chrome-operator handoffs.

chief-of-staff.note: Reads across FUB, Drive and Calendar for objective and target resolution before delegating.

certification_runs.note: Any live certification or recertification run requires all three. Verified in practice 2026-08-31: a run began with all three disconnected and correctly returned HOLD rather than substituting reported canonical versions for retrieved ones.
